sqloxide.wheel_note: The official manylinux wheels compile the same crates with optimisation; the image source-builds the pinned sdist with rustc -C instrument-coverage instead and does not install a published wheel.
sqloxide.license_evidence: LICENSE in the pinned sdist (SHA-256 4887ed0505457d387e7f7effda202be2374379f4fecf491e54ca67f59a77640b) and pyproject license = "MIT"

sqlparser.release_evidence: Cargo.lock in the pinned sdist (crates.io registry source with checksum); the build runs maturin with --locked
sqlparser.role: SQL tokenizer and recursive-descent parser that sqloxide.parse_sql calls

build_backend.rust: rust image toolchain 1.99.1 (RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN overrides the sdist's floating rust-toolchain file)
